regime_context: The detector paints a narrow, one-narrative tape: Coal leads by rank and is the only 'eligible' theme besides Banks, while Gold Miners is the only other high-score challenger but is ineligible and unscorable. Critically, backtest_verdict shows gate_helps=false for this market (the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown here — mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so the only validated edge does not apply to China A-shares; everything here is display-only and direction accuracy is poor (0.337). I will keep the note minimal and low conviction.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners sits at rank 2 with score 0.935 but is ineligible, unscorable, and has zero breadth — if it gains both eligibility and a scorable proxy while Coal's durability bar fades below 0.4, that would be a confirmed leadership handoff worth re-reading. Watching for: Gold Miners becomes eligible AND Coal's score drops below Gold Miners' score for 5 consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the single dominant, eligible narrative with the highest score and one_narrative=true, giving it the cleanest leadership read among scorable themes. However, its hurst_tag is mean-revert (not trend), durability_bar is only 0.52, and breadth is just 0.5 — leadership is real but fragile. Because the trend gate did not hold on this market's history, I treat this as a conditional lean on persistence, not a return forecast.
evidence: one_narrative=true, only theme with nontrivial breadth among eligible names
hurst_tag=mean-revert and durability_bar=0.52 flag a habit of fading rather than trending
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting tape (hurst_tag) plus a below-median durability bar means the most likely path for a China cyclical leader is a sharp give-back; the only reason to stay overweight is that nothing else is eligible, not that Coal is strong.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS lags the CSI 300 by 3% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar is the weakest liquid, scorable theme in the set (score -0.532) with negative breadth and the deepest crowding_z of any non-defensive theme (-2.27), meaning flow is pointedly absent. On a mean-reverting tape where the trend gate whipsaws, the one robust read is avoiding names with no leadership and no flow support.
theses.dissent: Extreme negative crowding can precede a snap-back in A-shares if policy headlines shift; an 'avoid' on the weakest theme is only interesting if the market actually rotates away from Coal, which has not happened yet.

falsifier.text: 515790.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by 3% before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
